Here you can find a summary of the app\'s main features and usage instructions.
- Add, edit, delete items\n- Set quantity, price, expiry date, etc.\n- View item details and perform quick actions
- Create containers and sub-containers\n- Switch between different containers to view items\n- Container settings and management
- Create, edit, delete tags\n- Tag items for easier filtering
- Record items to purchase\n- Checked items can be automatically added back to inventory
- Barcode scanning for quick entry or search\n- Image recognition to assist with entry
- Set item reminders\n- Global reminder switch and strategy
- Data backup and restore\n- Cloud storage and sync (if enabled)
- Theme, color scheme and icons\n- Language switching and display mode

- Double-tap a container icon to enter its detail page
- Long-press a container icon for more actions (edit, delete, move, etc.)
- In list/grid mode, quickly adjust quantity using + / – buttons
- One-tap replenish inventory from completed shopping list items
- Search box supports fuzzy search for tags and item names — press Enter to search
- The "in" suffix (e.g. "Items in…") can be customized.
